faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Have Questions? We Have Answers!
faq.subtitle: Here you'll find answers to the most frequently asked questions about DigiBridge Academy

q1.question: What is DigiBridge and who is it for?
q1.answer: DigiBridge is a free educational platform that connects generations through digital learning. It's suitable for all seniors (50+) who want to learn more about technology, as well as young people (18-35) who want to become mentors.

q2.question: Is the platform paid?
q2.answer: No! DigiBridge is completely free. All courses, materials and mentoring support are available at no cost. The project is funded by Civic Innovation Fund and European programs.

q3.question: How can I register?
q3.answer: Registration is easy and quick! Click the 'Start Learning' button at the top of the page, fill in basic information and your profile will be ready in minutes. If you have difficulties, our mentors are always here to help.

q4.question: What courses do you offer?
q4.answer: We offer various courses on digital security, media literacy, civic participation, social media use, online banking and much more. All courses include video lessons, practical exercises and downloadable materials.

q5.question: How does the mentoring program work?
q5.answer: Each participant gets a personal young mentor who has completed special training. The mentor is available for questions via chat, video calls or live events. You can contact them whenever you need help.

q6.question: How can I become a mentor?
q6.answer: If you're between 18 and 35 years old and want to help seniors navigate technology, click 'Become a Mentor'. You'll complete a short training and receive a certificate. Mentoring is voluntary but provides valuable experience and skills.
